verdict.rationale: The dot runs on its own cloud computer and browser, separate from your machine, and can create tasks in pre-configured Codex cloud environments. App permissions and action rules can limit it to reads, such as reading email without sending. Together these give some isolation from live systems, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox or test mode, and connected apps like Gmail, Drive and GitHub act on real data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or mode, documented separation of test data from production data, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
